src: non-background marker pixels in the four row/column arms of the incomplete rectangular frame
path: from each marker, move straight outward away from the frame along its row or column, stopping before the next marker on that line or at the grid edge
trajectory: paint the traversed arm segment with the marker color, including the marker cell
transform: use the three-pixel L at one frame corner as the fill color for the union of the frame rows and columns, then redraw the complete rectangular border with the frame color
